episodeTitle.en: Lessons in product leadership and AI strategy from Glean, Google, Amazon, and Slack | Tamar Yehoshua
episodeTitle.zh: 来自Glean、谷歌、亚马逊和Slack的产品领导力与AI战略启示 | 塔玛·耶霍舒亚

guestBioOfficial.en: Tamar Yehoshua is the president of product and technology at Glean. Prior to joining Glean, Tamar was chief product officer at Slack, where she led product, design, and research as the company scaled, including a 10x increase in revenue, its public listing, and an acquisition by Salesforce. She also led product and engineering teams at Google, working on search, identity, and privacy, and at A9.com, an Amazon company. Tamar has served on the board of directors for RetailMeNot, ServiceNow, Snyk, and Yext. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why you don’t need to be a well-run company to win
guestBioOfficial.zh: 塔玛·耶霍舒亚（Tamar Yehoshua）是Glean的产研总裁。在加入Glean之前，塔玛曾担任Slack的首席产品官。在Slack规模扩张的过程中，她领导了产品、设计和研究团队，推动公司营收增长10倍，并成功完成上市及被Salesforce收购。此前，她还曾在谷歌和亚马逊旗下公司A9.com担任产品和工程团队负责人。塔玛现任RetailMeNot、ServiceNow、Snyk和Yext等多家公司的董事会成员。在我们的对话中，我们探讨了：•为何无需成为一家运营完善的公司也能胜出

title.en: Lessons in product leadership and AI strategy from Glean, Google, Amazon, and Slack | Tamar Yehoshua
title.zh: 来自Glean、谷歌、亚马逊和Slack的产品领导力与AI战略启示 | 塔玛·耶霍舒亚

summary.en: Tamar discusses what it takes to lead product and technology at a fast-scaling enterprise AI company like Glean, and the lessons from scaling Slack 10x and leading Search at Google. She covers how to build trustworthy AI products for enterprises, the interplay of product and engineering leadership, and how to maintain quality and momentum through hypergrowth. The episode is a senior operator's view of building serious enterprise software.
summary.zh: Tamar 探讨了在像 Glean 这样快速扩张的企业级 AI 公司中，领导产品与技术需要什么，以及从 Slack 十倍增长、在 Google 领导搜索中学到的经验。她涵盖了如何为企业打造值得信赖的 AI 产品、产品与工程领导力的相互作用，以及如何在超高速增长中保持品质与势头。本期是一位资深运营者对打造严肃企业级软件的透视。
